responsibilities: Design and develop normalized and denormalized data models to support reporting and data integration needs.
Apply dimensional modelling techniques to create efficient, scalable, and business-oriented data models.
Develop and maintain data transformations and models using SQL and dbt.
Translate business and reporting requirements into well-structured and reliable data models.
Develop and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards based on the underlying data models.
Analyze and improve existing data models and reporting solutions to ensure data quality, performance, and scalability.
Work closely with BI developers, data analysts, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective analytics solutions.
Contribute to the documentation of data models, data processes, and reporting solutions.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve data modelling and reporting processes.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Analyze and improve existing data models and reporting solutions to ensure data quality, performance, and scalability
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD emphasizes data quality, reliability, dimensional modelling rigor, and documentation with no velocity/speed language, coding as rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: The client/project... We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Data team
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: As an IT consultancy placing analytics engineers with an unnamed client, the JD gives no sector-specific or regulatory signal, a generic business-decision domain, moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: join our Data team... Analyze and improve existing data models and reporting solutions
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing Data team with established data models and Power BI reporting solutions to improve upon, but the role description doesn't indicate multiple distinct sub-teams or a large team size, a growing mid-stage function.
evidence.jd_authorship: an initial time allocation of approximately 70% data modelling and 30% Power BI report development
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name specific tools (SQL, dbt, Power BI) and a precise time-allocation split, giving a clear picture of daily work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Work closely with BI developers, data analysts, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective analytics solutions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role is centered on internal data/BI collaboration (BI developers, data analysts) delivering models and reports for internal consumption, an internal-data orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: Translate business and reporting requirements into well-structured and reliable data models... Continuously identify opportunities to improve data modelling and reporting processes
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Responsibilities are framed around translating requirements, developing, and improving existing processes rather than setting strategic direction, an execution framing.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tool usage or AI-infrastructure-building expectation appears anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: No explicit testing, data contracts, or dedicated data-quality-framework language appears; data quality is mentioned only as an outcome to ensure, not an owned testing practice.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely around delivery, data modelling, and reporting improvement with no risk, compliance, or reliability register.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Analyze and improve existing data models and reporting solutions to ensure data quality, performance, and scalability
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role maintains and improves existing data models and reporting solutions rather than building a function from scratch.
